title: Indian Ocean Thermal Expansion & Swell (1993–2025)
source: NASA MODIS Aqua SST & TOPEX/Poseidon/Jason Altimetry

records.explanation: 1993 TOPEX Launch Baseline: Calm 26.8°C ocean. Low, gentle sine-wave pad.
1997 Dipole Shift: +0.5°C warming lifts ocean chord pitch; +14.2mm sea level rise.
2001: Steady thermal absorption (+26.8mm). Warm mid-range frequency swell.
2005: Sea surface nears 28°C. Faster LFO wave modulation reflects deeper swells.
2010 Marine Heatwave: 28.4°C triggers higher harmonic overtone and louder swell.
2016 Coral Bleaching Peak: +0.7°C sudden jump! Sharp pitch rise and heavy vibrato.
2020: Sea level +94mm above 1993 baseline. High-energy resonant ocean chord.
2025 Critical Thermal High: 29.9°C & +111.5mm rise. Peak frequency & maximum wave pulse.
